thread:
incident-bot: ALERT: hosted-api us-west-2 — sustained queue growth detected >12k requests. p95=4.3s p99=18.2s, 502 rate 3.4%. dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/d/queues/us-west-2

jordan.oncall: grabbing it. paged eng-sre and ops. first check: is autoscaler flapping or hitting ceiling?

sara.ops: confirmed queue depth 12,300 and rising. autoscaler target groups at max (max_replicas=24). GPU pool usage 100% on all reserved nodes.

nate.sre: oncall here. seeing repeated OOM evictions on worker-3 and worker-7 over last 6m. logs: `OOMKilled` then container restart loop. suspect memory leak after recent runtime change.

ashley.eng: I rolled out the inference runtime bump 2h ago (commit c3f8a1). It's been stable in staging but could be adding memory per-session. rolling back to previous image now.

nate.sre: rollback in progress. triggering scale-up is pointless if quota is maxed. need quick mitigations: 1) shed non-essential routes 2) route small customers to secondary region (us-east-1) 3) enable model fallbacks to quantized variant.

lin.support: support triage: two enterprise customers (org-omega, corp-beta) report timeouts and errors. corp-beta has active jobs tied to batch pipelines. org-omega seeing request failures ~10-12%.

jordan.oncall: put a temporary low-priority token-rule: reject requests with `x-priority: low` and return 429 + Retry-After 30s. Can we gate internal dev/test API keys too?

sara.ops: implemented token-rule on edge proxies, started returning 429 for matching keys. queue dropped ~900 in 2m. :thumbsup:

nate.sre: also applied model fallback policy: route to `redwood/model-lite-q8` for customers flagged as non-SLA-critical. Config snippet applied: ```json
{"route":"/v1/generate","fallback_model":"redwood/model-lite-q8","threshold_ms":12000}```

ashley.eng: rollback complete on worker images, new pods coming up. but older pods still in crash loop — evictions slowed but not resolved.

incident-bot: deploy-bot initiated canary rollback: deploy 2 -> deploy 1. Canary progress: 4/6 canaries healthy.

jordan.oncall: Nate, what about autoscaler policy? can we temporarily raise max_replicas and request emergency quota from cloud?

nate.sre: we've requested quota bump via cloud console (request id rq-9982). if approved it takes ~12-18m. Meanwhile, I bumped max_replicas to 36 in cluster config to allow new nodes to join if quota permits. No immediate effect until nodes provision.

ashley.eng: adding a hot pool fallback: spin up smaller gpus (a100x-small) reserved for burst routing, will take ~6-8m. kicking off infra job: `./infra/provision_hot_pool --size 6 --type a100x-small --reason "midday-burst"`

sara.ops: started routing rule to divert non-enterprise traffic to hot pool once healthy.

lin.support: customer impact summary for ops -> SOC/CSM: org-omega (10% errors, intermittent latency 5-12s), corp-beta (timeouts on batch jobs, some retries failed). Elevated priority alert created (INC-2026-045).

jordan.oncall: good. please send short note to status page: "We're experiencing elevated latencies and errors in us-west-2; mitigation in progress; some customers may see 429s or slower responses." Keep it concise.

lin.support: posted short status update. added contact for affected enterprise CSMs.

nate.sre: telemetry: started streaming slow logs to s3 path s3://redwood-ops/incident/2876543210/ for postmortem. saved a sample of 500 slow traces and OOM logs.

ashley.eng: hot pool nodes are up (6/6), warmed with runtime-1 image. traffic diverted. p99 dropped from 18.2s -> 6.1s within 3m after diversion. queue depth trending down.

sara.ops: quota request approved (rq-9982) from cloud, provisioning additional capacity. autoscaler now created 8 more nodes, verifying.

nate.sre: still seeing a subset of pods in CrashLoopBackOff (old image). drained and cordoned those nodes; new pods stabilized.

jordan.oncall: nice work. preparing handoff to night oncall in 20m. who will be the primary for the postmortem?

ashley.eng: I'll lead the postmortem and own the runtime regression investigation. Nate will own autoscaler & infra follow-up. Sara will write the incident timeline and mitigation notes. Lin will handle customer impact and status cadence.

incident-bot: REMINDER: oncall handoff scheduled at 2876544800. :pager: Handoff checklist: slack thread update, runbook link, PSIRT if customers affected.

jordan.oncall: handing off in 18m. current status: queue 2,100 (down from 12,300), p95=1.4s p99=3.8s, error rate back to baseline 0.2%. Hot pool active. rollback confirmed. ticket INC-2026-045 updated.

lin.support: updated affected customers with ETA for full recovery (2h) and offered workarounds for corp-beta batch pipelines.

nate.sre: capturing KVs for postmortem: autoscaler hit ceiling (max=24), cloud quota delay, OOM regression in runtime bump, and insufficient pre-provisioned burst capacity. follow-ups: pre-warm hot-pool, autoscaler scale-in/out smoothing, add memory regression tests to CI.

ashley.eng: noted. saving a diff of the runtime change and memprofile dumps to the incident artifact bucket.

jordan.oncall: thanks all. handing off to night oncall @jane.who is now paged. I'll post final thread snapshot at handoff. :thumbsup:
